requirement: Place Details asks Google for the place's point, and a contribution offers it to the hub as a location; a copy that came from the hub is never sent back

oracle.ref: PR #1696 (feat); fix evidence: Before: Place Details did not ask for location, so contributions could not carry it
oracle.invariant: S1: the hub holds identity, location, name, phone and address observations; the location observation is accepted. S2: only the first is queued, with a location observation naming google_maps as its source; the other two offer nothing.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

a contribution offers the location Google gave this server
facts carry Google's point for the place
